role: Meaningful regression of the actual current raw-output classifier and its exact byte/path bindings

results.name: Filename alone never exempts an unbound raw-looking file
Exactly bound genuine failed-command capture is data
Exactly bound captured output in a real batch receipt is data
Wrong hash cannot exempt new or edited authored wording
Wrong byte count cannot exempt a changed capture
A plain file binding is not an execution receipt
Without an actual terminal exit no exemption
Actual authored/provider prompt remains in scope regardless of receipt text
